item.title: Anki ownership transferred to AnkiHub
item.description:
📝 It’s a feeling that’s been regrettably common of late, and I’ve come to realise that something has to change. We’ve had a symbiotic relationship for years, with their content creation and collaboration platform driving more users to Anki. Removing me as a bottleneck will allow things to move faster, encourage a more collaborative approach, and free up time for improvements that have been hard to prioritise, like UI polish.

item.title: Nvidia shares are down after report that its OpenAI investment stalled
item.description:

However, Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, had said to industry associates late last year that the $100 billion investment was nonbinding and not finalized.
